engine: Isolated PostgreSQL via PGlite; upgrades a V0.05.1 fixture containing synthetic originals and published snapshots. Not live Supabase.

checks.name: baseline proves former anonymous article endpoint was readable
upgrade preserves every stored article, original text, note and timestamp
former snapshots are preserved as inaccessible history
all three former public RPCs deny anonymous and every logged-in account
anonymous cannot call any private reading or editor RPC
other account has no project access and cannot list, read, navigate or save
former snapshot table denies direct access even with known schema name
RLS blocks a different user from reading original text directly
owner can list all 243 articles including former drafts in 100-row batches
search, sort and neighbor traversal share one full-library order
article detail returns the owner original and notes without losing line breaks
foreign article rows are excluded even for the configured owner
save ignores attempts to publish and never updates or recreates old snapshots
saving an unanalyzed article is allowed and it appears in the private library
migration and permissions repair can rerun without reopening public access
all P135 tables keep RLS enabled and all functions keep SECURITY INVOKER
other P projects and shared Auth users remain unchanged
health check reports private mode ready without exposing article content
new installation finishes privately with no transient committed public phase
